analysis: Integration pass over 23 units. Visible changes are docs and changelog (docs/architecture/inference.md, docs/developer/test.md, docs/provider/cli-reference.md, docs/reference/protocol-messages.md, two changelog.d files), tests (GLM5NextPromptPolicyTests, GLM5NextMediaRoutingTests), the libs/mlx-swift-lm submodule pointer bump (7bed821 to 6aef0a5, no diff visible), and GLM5NextPromptPolicy.swift as described by prior analyses. Behavior changes: (1) variable-frame-rate GLM video is indexed, with frame i timed at i/nominalFrameRate, instead of refused. (2) OpenRouter returned reasoning/reasoning_details text is replayed as reasoning_content. (3) strict tools are accepted, relying on ToolConstraintValidation.validate per auto call. (4) Empty-string tool arguments map to {}. (5) Null reasoning/thinking controls are tolerated and thinking is accepted as a Boolean or object. Hardening is retained per the docs and tests: unknown reasoning members, preserve_thinking, contradictory switches, forced tool choices and hidden reasoning are still refused, and the tests add fail-closed malformed-shape cases. Documented bounds are unchanged: 512 MiB decoded cap, 28,532 visual-token cap, media excluded from prefix lookup and capture (T-041/SEC-035 posture unchanged), and VisionMemoryGate reservation. Reasoning replay stays inside the requesting consumer's own prompt, and the cache salt is coordinator-authored, so no new cross-tenant surface is evident. No change touches TB-002 crypto, TB-011 App Attest authorization, keys, or attestation. No concrete regression is supported by the visible evidence. Unverified contracts that need code-level review: (a) the VFR decode path in GLM5NextProcessor.decodeAsset still enforces frame-count and decoded-byte caps before allocation, and writes no plaintext to temp files (T-050); (b) ToolConstraintValidation.validate fails closed on every strict auto call for streaming and non-streaming paths; (c) captured reasoning_content is checked for native delimiter tokens, since validateHistory sees SDK messages and may not see the captured text; (d) the opaque mlx-swift-lm submodule bump affects inference and cache code (T-041, TB-007). 63 source units were omitted from replay, so the review is incomplete.
